offlineSast.scope: Four local site-reproduction patterns; supplemental, not the registry auto gate
offlineSast.rules:
rules:
  - id: m104-f2.manual-html-escaping
    languages: [javascript, typescript]
    severity: ERROR
    message: Use the existing contextual serializer rather than chained entity replacements.
    pattern-either:
      - pattern: $VALUE.replaceAll('&', '&')
      - pattern: $VALUE.replaceAll('<', '<')
      - pattern: $VALUE.replaceAll('>', '>')
      - pattern: $VALUE.replaceAll('"', '"')
  - id: m104-f2.generated-script-placeholder
    languages: [javascript, typescript]
    severity: ERROR
    message: The native host inserts its reviewed bridge; the generator must not emit executable placeholders.
    pattern: $HTML.replace('</head>', '<script nonce="__MUSE_NONCE__">__MUSE_BRIDGE__</script></head>')
  - id: m104-f2.dynamic-schema-regexp
    languages: [javascript, typescript]
    severity: ERROR
    message: Schema pattern source must select a reviewed literal, never be compiled.
    pattern: new RegExp($SOURCE, 'u')
  - id: m104-f2.launcher-command
    languages: [java]
    severity: ERROR
    message: Resolve a regular executable and pass its complete command as an argument list.
    pattern: new ProcessBuilder($LAUNCHER, "panel", "--stdio")
